mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8.0% signals a weak labor market that triggers government stimulus, compressing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 8.0%), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals accelerating economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both UNRATE declines and RSAFS increases, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and rising for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and rising for 3 months), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals robust manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO > 0.5%), or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 700.0 thousand units signal strong residential construction, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 700.0), or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals broad-based economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annualized inflation rate above 2.0% (as measured by CPIAUCSL) signals an inflationary environment that triggers monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.0%), or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
